notes: Added 2026-10-24 by PLC Studio (verification batch 2, group Verify2) to verify fail-safe and LAD rules against TIA V21; imported with plc_import_documents, compiled, exported with plc_export_block (documents, tool text without BOM). Bool, Int, DInt, Word and Time are the elementary types TIA accepts in the interface of an F-block (compare B39); a PLC data type (UDT_FSignals, C24) is accepted too.
